# `kaolin/ops/mesh/MeshSubdivision.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/ops/mesh/MeshSubdivision.js`

MeshSubdivision.js — Loop & Catmull-Clark Subdivision Subdivision surface algorithms for the Kaolin geometry toolkit. Loop Subdivision (Charles Loop, 1987): - Operates on triangle meshes only - Inserts edge midpoints, reconnects into 4 sub-triangles per face - Uses β-weighting for smooth limit surface (Warren weights) - Boundary edges get special 1/8, 3/4, 1/8 stencil Catmull-Clark Subdivision (Catmull & Clark, 1978): - Operates on quad or mixed meshes - Face points → edge points → vertex points → reconnect - Converges to C² (bi-cubic B-spline) surface away from extraordinary verts - Triangle input is first converted to all-quad via 1-to-3 split Both algorithms support: - Boundary handling (crease preservation) - Pinned vertices (kept fixed) - Multiple subdivision levels Data format matches MeshOps.js: positions: Float32Array — stride 3 indices:   Uint32Array  — stride 3 (triangles) or stride 4 (quads)

## Functions

### `loopSubdivide(positions, indices, options = {})`

Perform one level of Loop subdivision on a triangle mesh.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3 (triangles only)
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.pinned` *(Set|null)* — — vertex indices to keep fixed
- `options.creases` *(Set|null)* — — edge keys (lo*0x100000+hi) to treat as creases

**Returns:** }

### `catmullClarkSubdivide(positions, faceIndices, faceVertCounts, options = {})`

Perform one level of Catmull-Clark subdivision. Input can be triangle or quad faces (mixed is allowed). - triangles: indices stride 3, faceVertCounts = [3, 3, ...] - quads:     indices stride 4, faceVertCounts = [4, 4, ...] - mixed:     flat indices + faceVertCounts array For simplicity, this implementation accepts two formats: 1. (positions, quadIndices) — all-quad, quadIndices = Uint32Array stride 4 2. (positions, triIndices, { triangleInput: true }) — converts tris to quads first

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `faceIndices` *(Uint32Array)* — — flat face indices
- `faceVertCounts` *(number[])* — — verts per face (3 or 4 each)
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.pinned` *(Set|null)* — — vertices to keep fixed

**Returns:** }

### `catmullClarkSubdivideMulti(positions, faceIndices, faceVertCounts, levels = 1, options = {})`

Perform multiple levels of Catmull-Clark subdivision.
